note_en: 由 introduces the person or body that does the action, a bit like English "by" in a passive sentence: 居委会成员一般由本地居民选举产生 "committee members are generally elected by local residents." But the verb itself doesn't change form the way English "elect" becomes "are elected". The same 由 also means "made up of" in 由不同层级的机构组成 "made up of bodies at different levels."
